Here’s a **clean, scalable concept + technical architecture** for **TourCoaster.com** as a global tour guide network with **physical + VR access**, designed natively for **Jekyll Pages**.

---

# 🌍 TOURCOASTER — CORE CONCEPT

TourCoaster is a **hybrid exploration network** connecting:

1. 🧭 Physical guides (hiking + city tours)
2. 🌐 Digital explorers (self-guided travelers)
3. 🥽 VR users (remote + accessibility users)
4. ♿ Inclusive access layer (disability-first tourism)

Think:

> “Airbnb Experiences + AllTrails + Google Earth VR + Wikipedia travel guides — unified.”

---

# 🧠 1. PRODUCT ARCHITECTURE

## A. Core Modules

### 1. 🌍 Tour Network Layer

* Verified global tour guides
* City guides + hiking guides
* Local experiences (nature, culture, food, architecture)
* Ratings + trust scoring

---

### 2. 🗺️ Route Engine

* GPS-based trails (hikes + urban walks)
* AI-generated “recommended paths”
* Difficulty + accessibility tagging
* Weather + safety integration

---

### 3. 🥽 VR EXPERIENCE LAYER

For users who:

* cannot travel
* have disabilities
* want preview experiences

Includes:

* 360° immersive tours
* Guided narration (AI or human voice)
* “Live walk mode” (recorded guide walking in real time)
* Scenic replay (nature loops, city flythroughs)

---

### 4. ♿ Accessibility Layer

* Audio-first navigation mode
* Wheelchair-accessible routing filters
* “Virtual mobility” VR mode
* Sign language overlays (future)

---

### 5. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Community Layer

* Guide profiles
* Traveler profiles
* Trip journals
* Community itineraries
* Reviews + reputation system

---

### 6. 💰 Marketplace Layer

* Booking tours
* VR content monetization
* Subscriptions (Explorer Pass)
* Guide revenue share

---

# 🧱 2. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE (HIGH LEVEL)

```
Frontend (Jekyll Static Site)
        ↓
API Layer (optional: Supabase / Firebase / Node)
        ↓
Content System (Markdown + JSON + Geo data)
        ↓
Media Layer (360 videos, VR assets, images)
        ↓
Optional: AI layer (recommendations + route generation)
```

---

# 🗂️ 3. JEKYLL SITE STRUCTURE

## 📁 Base Structure

```
tourcoaster/
├── _config.yml
├── _data/
│   ├── guides.yml
│   ├── tours.yml
│   ├── routes.yml
│   ├── cities.yml
│   ├── hikes.yml
│   └── vr_experiences.yml
│
├── _layouts/
│   ├── default.html
│   ├── tour.html
│   ├── guide.html
│   ├── city.html
│   ├── hike.html
│   ├── vr.html
│   └── map.html
│
├── _includes/
│   ├── header.html
│   ├── footer.html
│   ├── tour-card.html
│   ├── guide-card.html
│   ├── vr-player.html
│   └── mapbox.html
│
├── _tours/
├── _guides/
├── _cities/
├── _hikes/
├── _vr/
│
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   ├── js/
│   ├── vr/
│   ├── images/
│   └── 360/
│
├── pages/
│   ├── index.md
│   ├── explore.md
│   ├── maps.md
│   ├── vr.md
│   ├── accessibility.md
│   ├── become-a-guide.md
│   └── about.md
```

---

# 📄 4. CONTENT MODELS (Jekyll DATA STRUCTURE)

## 🧭 Guide (`_data/guides.yml`)

```yml
- id: guide_001
  name: "Elena Rivera"
  location: "Barcelona"
  specialties:
    - urban tours
    - architecture
    - food culture
  languages:
    - English
    - Spanish
  rating: 4.9
  vr_enabled: true
  experience_years: 6
```

---

## 🗺️ Tour (`_data/tours.yml`)

```yml
- id: tour_001
  title: "Old Town Barcelona Walk"
  type: "city"
  guide_id: guide_001
  duration: "2.5h"
  difficulty: "easy"
  accessibility: "partial"
  geo_path:
    - [41.3851, 2.1734]
    - [41.3839, 2.1762]
  vr_available: true
  media:
    cover: "/assets/images/barcelona_oldtown.jpg"
    vr_360: "/assets/360/barcelona_oldtown.mp4"
```

---

## 🏔️ Hike (`_data/hikes.yml`)

```yml
- id: hike_001
  name: "Mont Blanc Scenic Trail"
  difficulty: "hard"
  elevation_gain: 1200
  duration: "6h"
  gps_track: "/assets/gps/montblanc.gpx"
  vr_preview: true
```

---

## 🥽 VR Experience (`_data/vr_experiences.yml`)

```yml
- id: vr_001
  title: "Walk Through Kyoto Temples"
  location: "Kyoto"
  type: "immersive_walk"
  duration: "15m"
  accessibility: "full"
  narration: "human_ai_mixed"
  assets:
    video_360: "/assets/vr/kyoto.mp4"
    audio: "/assets/vr/kyoto_audio.mp3"
```

---

# 🧭 5. WEBSITE EXPERIENCE DESIGN

## 🏠 Homepage

* Global map (interactive)
* “Explore now” search bar
* Featured tours
* VR entry point

---

## 🗺️ Explore Page

Filters:

* City / Nature
* Difficulty
* Accessibility
* VR available
* Live guides

---

## 🥽 VR Page (KEY DIFFERENTIATOR)

Sections:

* “Travel without moving”
* Featured immersive tours
* Accessibility mode
* VR headset compatibility

---

## 🧑 Guide Profile Page

* Bio
* Tours offered
* Live availability
* VR recordings
* Reviews
* Booking button

---

## ♿ Accessibility Page

* Supported modes
* VR assist features
* Audio tours
* High contrast UI

---

# 🧠 6. INTELLIGENCE LAYER (OPTIONAL BUT POWERFUL)

## AI Functions

* Generate itinerary from preferences
* Suggest routes based on weather + fitness
* Auto-generate VR narration scripts
* Summarize tours into “preview mode”

Example:

> “3-day Kyoto cultural immersion under light walking conditions”

---

# 🧩 7. VR SYSTEM OPTIONS

## Option A (MVP)

* 360° video playback
* Embedded YouTube/Vimeo VR
* WebXR viewer

## Option B (Advanced)

* Three.js WebXR scenes
* Interactive hotspots
* Spatial audio

## Option C (Future)

* Full metaverse twin of cities
* Real-time guide avatars
* AI-guided exploration

---

# 💡 8. DIFFERENTIATION

TourCoaster is NOT:

* just booking tours
* just travel blog
* just maps

It becomes:

> 🌐 “The accessibility-first global exploration layer of the real world”
